parameters.jsCode: const TIMEZONE = 'Asia/Manila'; const now = new Date(); const todayDate = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', { timeZone: TIMEZONE, year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit' }).format(now); const p = todayDate.split('-'); const t = new Date(Date.UTC(Number(p[0]), Number(p[1]) - 1, Number(p[2]))); t.setUTCDate(t.getUTCDate() + 1); const targetDate = t.toISOString().slice(0, 10); const displayDate = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone: TIMEZONE, month: 'long', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' }).format(t); const todayDisplayDate = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone: TIMEZONE, month: 'long', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' }).format(now); const clock = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', { timeZone: TIMEZONE, hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hour12: false }).format(now); const cp = clock.split(':'); const nowMinutes = Number(cp[0]) * 60 + Number(cp[1]); const nextRunShort = nowMinutes < 480 ? 'Today, 8:00 AM' : (nowMinutes < 1200 ? 'Today, 8:00 PM' : 'Tomorrow, 8:00 AM'); return [{ json: { targetDate: targetDate, displayDate: displayDate, todayDate: todayDate, todayDisplayDate: todayDisplayDate, timezone: TIMEZONE, nowMinutes: nowMinutes, nextRunShort: nextRunShort } }];

const START_DATE_FIELD = 'Start Date'; const STATUS_FIELD = 'Status'; const RENTER_FIELD = 'Renter Name'; const PICKUP_TIME_FIELD = 'Time'; const RETURN_FIELD = 'End Date'; const DEVICE_FIELD = 'device'; const ADDRESS_FIELD = 'Address'; const NOTES_FIELD = 'Notes'; const REMAINING_FIELD = 'Balance'; const DOWN_PAYMENT_FIELD = 'Down Payment'; const DIVE_CASE_FIELD = 'Dive Case'; const ACTIVE_STATUSES = ['booked', 'released']; const DIVE_NO = ['no', 'n', 'none', 'n/a', 'na', 'nil', 'null', '-', '—', '0', 'false', 'x']; const TODAY_GRACE_MIN = 30; const DUE_SOON_HOURS = 12; const ref = $('Calculate Tomorrow').first().json; const target = ref.targetDate; const today = ref.todayDate; const nowM = ref.nowMinutes; const nowMs = Date.now(); function normDate(v) { if (v === null || v === undefined || v === '') return ''; if (typeof v === 'number') { const b = new Date(Date.UTC(1899, 11, 30)); b.setUTCDate(b.getUTCDate() + Math.floor(v)); return b.toISOString().slice(0, 10); } const s = String(v).trim(); const m = s.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/); if (m) return m[0]; const d = new Date(s); if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return ''; return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', { timeZone: 'Asia/Manila', year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit' }).format(d); } function shortDate(iso) { if (iso === '') return ''; const d = new Date(iso + 'T00:00:00Z'); if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return iso; return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone: 'Asia/Manila', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }).format(d); } function cleanTime(v) { const s = v === null || v === undefined ? '' : String(v).trim(); if (s === '') return ''; const m = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(:\d{2})?\s*([AaPp][Mm])?$/); if (m) return m[1] + ':' + m[2] + (m[4] ? ' ' + m[4].toUpperCase() : ''); return s; } function mins(t) { if (t === null || t === undefined || t === '') return 99999; const s = String(t).trim().toUpperCase(); const m = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(:\d{2})?\s*(AM|PM)?$/); if (!m) return 99999; let h = Number(m[1]); const mi = Number(m[2]); const ap = m[4]; if (ap === 'PM' && h < 12) h += 12; if (ap === 'AM' && h === 12) h = 0; return h * 60 + mi; } function dueInfo(ed, pt) { const m = mins(pt); if (ed === '' || m >= 99999) return { text: '', hours: null }; const p = ed.split('-'); if (p.length !== 3) return { text: '', hours: null }; const retMs = Date.UTC(Number(p[0]), Number(p[1]) - 1, Number(p[2])) + m * 60000 - 8 * 3600000; const h = (retMs - nowMs) / 3600000; if (h > 0 && h <= DUE_SOON_HOURS) return { text: 'Due back in ~' + Math.max(1, Math.round(h)) + 'h', hours: h }; if (h <= 0) return { text: 'Return time passed', hours: h }; return { text: '', hours: null }; } function daysBetween(a, b) { if (a === '' || b === '') return null; const da = new Date(a + 'T00:00:00Z'); const db = new Date(b + 'T00:00:00Z'); if (isNaN(da.getTime()) || isNaN(db.getTime())) return null; const n = Math.round((db - da) / 86400000); return n < 1 ? 1 : n; } function isActive(st) { const slow = st.trim().toLowerCase(); for (const k of ACTIVE_STATUSES) { if (slow === k) return true; } return false; } function diveYes(v) { const s = v === null || v === undefined ? '' : String(v).trim().toLowerCase(); if (s === '') return 'No'; for (const k of DIVE_NO) { if (s === k) return 'No'; } return 'Yes'; } const legacy = []; for (const it of $input.all()) { const c = it.json || {}; legacy.push({ device: c.device || '', 'Start Date': c.startDate || '', 'End Date': c.endDate || '', 'Time': c.timeRaw || '', 'Status': c.statusRaw || '', 'Renter Name': c.renterName || '', 'Address': c.address || '', 'Notes': c.notes || '', 'Balance': c.balance || '', 'Down Payment': c.downPayment || '', 'Dive Case': c.diveCase || '' }); } const out = []; for (const item of legacy) { const j = item; const sd = normDate(j[START_DATE_FIELD]); const ed = normDate(j[RETURN_FIELD]); const st = j[STATUS_FIELD] !== undefined && j[STATUS_FIELD] !== null ? String(j[STATUS_FIELD]) : ''; if (!isActive(st)) continue; const isRel = st.trim().toLowerCase() === 'released'; const rawTime = j[PICKUP_TIME_FIELD] !== undefined && j[PICKUP_TIME_FIELD] !== null ? String(j[PICKUP_TIME_FIELD]).trim() : ''; const pt = rawTime; const tDisp = cleanTime(rawTime); const dayKind = sd === today ? 'today' : (sd === target ? 'tomorrow' : ''); const pickupAt = sd !== '' && tDisp !== '' ? shortDate(sd) + ', ' + tDisp : (sd !== '' ? shortDate(sd) : tDisp); const returnAt = ed !== '' && tDisp !== '' ? shortDate(ed) + ', ' + tDisp : (ed !== '' ? shortDate(ed) : ''); const di = dueInfo(ed, pt); const base = { device: j[DEVICE_FIELD] || '', renter: j[RENTER_FIELD] || '', bookingDate: sd, pickupTime: pt, pickupAt: pickupAt, returnInfo: j[RETURN_FIELD] || '', returnAt: returnAt, status: st, address: j[ADDRESS_FIELD] || '', notes: j[NOTES_FIELD] || '', remaining: j[REMAINING_FIELD] || '', downPayment: j[DOWN_PAYMENT_FIELD] || '', diveCase: diveYes(j[DIVE_CASE_FIELD]), durationDays: daysBetween(sd, ed), dueSoon: di.text, hoursLeft: di.hours }; if (!isRel) { if (dayKind === 'today' && mins(pt) + TODAY_GRACE_MIN >= nowM) { base.section = 'today'; out.push({ json: base }); } else if (dayKind === 'tomorrow') { base.section = 'tomorrow'; out.push({ json: base }); } else if (dayKind === '' && ed === today && sd !== today) { base.section = 'return'; out.push({ json: base }); } } else { if (ed === today) { base.section = 'return'; out.push({ json: base }); } else if (ed === target) { base.section = 'dueback'; out.push({ json: base }); } } } out.sort((a, b) => { const order = { today: 0, tomorrow: 1, return: 2, dueback: 3 }; const o = order[a.json.section] - order[b.json.section]; if (o !== 0) return o; if (a.json.section === 'today' || a.json.section === 'tomorrow') { const d = mins(a.json.pickupTime) - mins(b.json.pickupTime); if (d !== 0) return d; } const dv = String(a.json.device).localeCompare(String(b.json.device)); if (dv !== 0) return dv; return String(a.json.renter).localeCompare(String(b.json.renter)); }); const rows = out.map(o => o.json); return [{ json: { targetDate: target, displayDate: ref.displayDate, todayDate: today, todayDisplayDate: ref.todayDisplayDate, todayShort: shortDate(today), displayShort: shortDate(target), timezone: ref.timezone, nextRunShort: ref.nextRunShort, count: rows.length, bookings: rows } }];

const d = $input.first().json; const EMOJI = { 'Iphone 13': '📱', 'Canon EOS R50': '📷', 'Insta360 X5': '🎥', 'DJI Osmo Pocket 3': '🚁' }; const SEP = '━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━'; const DUE_SOON_HOURS = 12; function esc(v) { return String(v === null || v === undefined ? '' : v).replace(/&/g, '&').replace(//g, '>'); } function val(v, emptyText) { const s = v === null || v === undefined ? '' : String(v).trim(); if (s === '') return emptyText === undefined ? '—' : emptyText; return esc(s); } function dpVal(v) { const s = v === null || v === undefined ? '' : String(v).trim(); if (s === '') return '₱0'; const n = parseFloat(s.replace(/[^0-9.\-]/g, '')); if (isNaN(n)) return esc(s); return '₱' + n.toLocaleString('en-US'); } function durVal(n) { if (n === null || n === undefined) return '—'; return n + (n === 1 ? ' day' : ' days'); } function isInsta(b) { return String(b.device || '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'insta360 x5'; } function head(b) { const icon = EMOJI[String(b.device)] ? EMOJI[String(b.device)] + ' ' : ''; const name = String(b.device || '').trim() === '' ? 'Booking' : String(b.device).trim(); return icon + '' + esc(name) + ''; } function dueLine(b, L) { const s = b.dueSoon === null || b.dueSoon === undefined ? '' : String(b.dueSoon).trim(); if (s !== '') L.push('⏳ ' + esc(s) + ''); } function devName(b) { const icon = EMOJI[String(b.device)] ? EMOJI[String(b.device)] + ' ' : ''; const name = String(b.device || '').trim() === '' ? 'Booking' : String(b.device).trim(); const who = String(b.renter || '').trim() === '' ? '' : ' - ' + b.renter; return icon + esc(name) + esc(who); } function countdown(b) { const h = b.hoursLeft; if (h === null || h === undefined || isNaN(h)) return '—'; if (h <= 0) return 'return time passed'; return 'back in ~' + Math.max(1, Math.round(h)) + 'h'; } function isDue(b) { const h = b.hoursLeft; return h !== null && h !== undefined && !isNaN(h) && h <= DUE_SOON_HOURS; } function block(b) { const L = []; L.push(SEP); L.push(''); L.push(head(b)); L.push(''); L.push('👤 Renter: ' + val(b.renter)); L.push('🕐 Pickup: ' + val(b.pickupAt)); L.push('↩️ Return: ' + val(b.returnAt)); L.push('⏱️ Duration: ' + durVal(b.durationDays)); dueLine(b, L); if (isInsta(b)) L.push('🤿 Dive Case: ' + val(b.diveCase)); L.push('📍 Address: ' + val(b.address, 'N/A')); L.push('🏷️ Status: ' + val(b.status)); L.push('📝 Notes: ' + val(b.notes, 'N/A')); L.push('💵 Down Payment: ' + dpVal(b.downPayment)); L.push('💳 Balance: ' + dpVal(b.remaining)); return L.join('\n'); } const lines = []; lines.push('📅 UPCOMING BOOKINGS'); const td = d.bookings.filter(b => b.section === 'today'); const tm = d.bookings.filter(b => b.section !== 'today' && b.section !== 'return' && b.section !== 'dueback'); const due = d.bookings.filter(b => (b.section === 'return' || b.section === 'dueback') && isDue(b)).sort((a, b) => a.hoursLeft - b.hoursLeft); if (td.length + tm.length === 0) { lines.push('No upcoming bookings today or tomorrow (' + esc(d.todayDisplayDate) + ' - ' + esc(d.displayDate) + ').'); } else { if (td.length > 0) { lines.push(''); lines.push('Today, ' + esc(d.todayShort || d.todayDisplayDate) + ' - ' + td.length + (td.length === 1 ? ' booking' : ' bookings')); lines.push(''); for (const b of td) lines.push(block(b)); } if (tm.length > 0) { lines.push(''); lines.push('Tomorrow, ' + esc(d.displayShort || d.displayDate) + ' - ' + tm.length + (tm.length === 1 ? ' booking' : ' bookings')); lines.push(''); for (const b of tm) lines.push(block(b)); } } lines.push(''); lines.push('↩️ DUE FOR RETURN - ' + due.length + (due.length === 1 ? const d = $input.first().json; const nxt = d.nextRunShort ? '\n\n⏭ Next check: ' + d.nextRunShort : ''; return [{ json: { telegramMessage: 'No upcoming bookings today or tomorrow (' + d.todayDisplayDate + ' - ' + d.displayDate + ').' + nxt, count: 0, displayDate: d.displayDate } }];

parameters.content:
## Next-Day Booking Reminder — live config
Schedule: hourly (workflow timezone set; instance default UTC). Change gate: Send Reminder? / Send Note? compare Compute Stable Hash against lastReminderHash in _State — unchanged runs stop silently, no delete/send.
Sheets: Bookings Core sub-workflow (reads 4 device tabs + normalizes rows) + Read Bot State (_State tab: Key | Value) + Read Reminder Hash. OAuth credential lives on the Core reads.
Columns: Start Date / End Date / Time (= pickup AND return time, 24h convention) / Status / Renter Name / Address / Notes / Remaining / Down Payment. Insta360-only: Dive Case → Yes/No.
HEADER VARIANCE: balance column is Balance in iPhone/Canon tabs but Remaining in DJI/Insta360 tabs — Core prefers Balance, falls back to Remaining. Do not assume one header everywhere.
STATUS MODEL: Booked = secured, upcoming (pickup sections). Released = unit is OUT (return tracking). Only Returned/Available/Pending/etc. stop reminding.
DRAFT CONVENTION: Status is the commit signal — fill it in last. Blank-status rows are invisible to every output.
MESSAGE: two sections. 1) Upcoming pickups (full blocks; explicit none-line when empty). 2) Due for return (compact one-line countdowns, soonest first). Per-block countdown lines on pickups.
ONE MESSAGE: each group send deletes the previous group message first (message id tracked in _State under lastMessageId; missing-message delete failures are tolerated). Dev DM sends never touch group state.
Message: single Telegram send from Build Reminder Message — fan out future channels (Discord/Messenger) from that node.
Telegram: bot credential attached; group chat on group Sends, personal DM on Dev Sends.
DEBUG: Run Settings.isDebug = true routes both Sends to your DM with a DEV-TEST prefix. Default false (group). Remember to set false + publish when done testing.
On-demand: On-Demand Entry trigger (sub-workflow calls) + Booking Reminder On-Demand workflow (group button + /check).
Do not add :latest, do not embed secrets (credentials only).

parameters.jsCode: const d = $input.first().json; const rows = d.bookings || []; const stableSrc = rows.map(b => [b.device, b.renter, b.bookingDate, b.pickupTime, b.returnInfo, b.status, b.section, b.address, b.notes, b.remaining, b.downPayment, b.diveCase, b.durationDays].join('|')).join('~') + '~' + d.targetDate + '~' + d.todayDate + '~' + d.nextRunShort; let hh = 5381; for (let i = 0; i < stableSrc.length; i += 1) { hh = ((hh << 5) + hh + stableSrc.charCodeAt(i)) | 0; } d.stableHash = 'h' + (hh >>> 0).toString(36); return [{ json: d }];

const cur = $('Compute Stable Hash').first().json.stableHash; const prev = $('Read Reminder Hash').first().json.Value; const s = String(cur || ''); return [{ json: { changed: s !== String(prev || ''), stableHash: s } }];

const cur = $('Compute Stable Hash').first().json.stableHash; const prev = $('Read Reminder Hash').first().json.Value; const s = String(cur || ''); return [{ json: { changed: s !== String(prev || ''), stableHash: s } }];
